headlines.title: Geely’s AI fast charging ‘heals’ EV batteries for 20% more cycle life
headlines.summary:
Geely says its new AI-powered fast charging system can reverse some of the battery damage caused by fast charging, using micro-pulse currents to add up to 20% more cycle life.



Charging a car in under 5 minutes is great, but not if it wears the battery out years early.  Geely claims that its ‘Smart Charging’ addresses that and it is using something that sounds like sorcery.

headlines.title: Tesla’s ‘hardcore lawyers’ went a little too hardcore
headlines.summary:
Tesla’s racism trial in California opened Monday with a bad day for the company’s lawyers. The first witness testified that a senior Tesla in-house attorney had called him last week and let him believe he was working for the state, according to Law360 (paywall).



That same morning, Tesla’s outside counsel told the judge the N-word is a “term of respect and endearment” in the Black community. Bot

headlines.title: Musk pitches 200-mph Austin-San Antonio ‘Hyperloop’ tunnel, again
headlines.summary:
Elon Musk says the Boring Company is working on a 200-mph “Hyperloop” tunnel between Austin and San Antonio that would cut the drive to under 30 minutes. He posted the claim on X this weekend with no route, no timeline, and no cost.



It’s a version of a promise Musk has been making for more than a decade. So far, he hasn’t built any of them.
